seasonal-wildlife
=================

Tags: fort | gameplay | animals

A windowed tool to curate and seasonally rotate your embark's wildlife. Detects
the
creatures that can actually visit your fort (per biome), lets you allow/block
them, set
relative abundance, and assign each to seasons via a preference/food-web matrix.
All
changes are live (no reload), including adding a species not native to the
embark.

Every species the tool manages, on every layer, is ACTIVE with one or more
seasons or INACTIVE and
never appears. Demons, megabeasts, titans, forgotten beasts, night creatures and
mythic creatures are
DF's own and are left to it.

Nine tabs: Overview (what the map holds now), Panel (every switch, the jobs, all
on / all off), Roster
(active or inactive, seasons, per-layer targets, fills, the climate matrix),
Seasons, Food web, Live
(groups on the map), Layers, Vermin (by family) and Ledger (every write, with
undo). The window is
gui/seasonal-wildlife.lua; this script is the engine and the console.

Usage::

    gui/seasonal-wildlife            open the window
    seasonal-wildlife status         the embark's manageable creatures, layers,
    quotas, fuse line
    seasonal-wildlife now            apply the current season's roster once
    seasonal-wildlife enable|disable automatic seasonal rotation on/off
    seasonal-wildlife preset          the embark's preset: every present layer

    seasonal-wildlife undo            un
